from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs/task-1e62bf00.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    hr=next((i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in r)),None)
    if hr is not None:
        pix=[(r,c) for r in range(h) if r!=hr for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
        if not pix: return g
        top=min(r for r,c in pix); bot=max(r for r,c in pix)
        if bot<hr:
            target_bot=hr-1; shift=target_bot-bot; line=top+shift-1
        else:
            target_top=hr+1; shift=target_top-top; line=bot+shift+1
        for r in range(top,bot+1):
            for c in range(w):
                nr=r+shift
                if 0<=nr<h: g[nr][c]=g[r][c]
        # Clear the old footprint only where it is not part of translated object.
        old={(r,c) for r,c in pix}; new={(r+shift,c) for r,c in pix}
        for r,c in old-new: g[r][c]=bg
        if 0<=line<h: g[line]=[8]*w
        return g
    vc=next(i for i in range(w) if all(g[r][i]==2 for r in range(h)))
    pix=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if c!=vc and g[r][c]!=bg]
    if not pix: return g
    left=min(c for r,c in pix); right=max(c for r,c in pix)
    if right<vc: shift=(vc-1)-right; col=left+shift-1
    else: shift=(vc+1)-left; col=right+shift+1
    for r,c in pix: g[r][c+shift]=g[r][c]
    for r,c in pix: g[r][c]=bg
    if 0<=col<w:
        for r in range(h): g[r][col]=8
    return g
''')
